reviews.text:
Dog went for the assessment. Looked very excited to be there, could not wait to go in. Made new friends, came back and slept like a log.

She approves.

Our lab mix loves coming here and playing all day with his friends. We've been coming here since he was about 6 months old, and it's nice that there are so many familiar faces working that know him and are excited to see him when we drop him off. After a day of daycare, he's so tired that he sleeps all evening and most of the next day! It's a huge relief to be able to go out of town and know that he is well-cared for and having a blast with his friends. We've boarded him for both short weekend trips and longer stays, and every time we drop him off, he's trying to sprint in the door from a block down the street. The postcard photos are a good add-on for us, we love seeing what he's up to while he's there. Thanks to the Dogaholics staff who make the experience so great!!
Love Dogaholics! They seem to genuinely care about our precious Joey. Grooming & Boarding are both great!
Hi Moshe, thank you so much for your 5-star review! The Dogaholics team truly appreciates your support.
Hi Emily, thank you so much for the 5 star review. From the Dogaholics team, we are very grateful!

Their website is misleading and should be updated so first-time visits cannot be booked through their online booking system. I scheduled a booking online for my pup’s first visit and uploaded all the required documents. However, when we arrived that morning, we were told he couldn’t stay because he first needed an assessment. An employee explained that all first-time visits must be booked through the front desk, but this is not stated anywhere on the website. I completely understand the need for an assessment, but the booking process needs to be much clearer online. We were excited to start having my pup attend daycare there, but ultimately decided to choose another service after this experience.

Staff is great always remember Leroy .
He has a great time and the staff loves him
Dogaholics is my dog’s favorite place outside of our home. She loves to go there and runs in the door whenever I drop her off. The staff are friendly and are helpful.
I always feel so comfortable leaving my bb at Dogaholics. I know she will have the BEST time and that they will look out for her. Excited for my puppy to attend as well once she is spayed(:
Thank you so much for the 5 star review. We truly appreciate your support. From the Dogaholics team, we are very grateful.

Dogaholics is truly a one of kind daycare establishment in the city. They take such amazing care of the dogs and give them so much love and attention that I haven't really seen at other places. My dog is visually impaired and all employees have been so accommodating to her needs. There is honestly not one thing I would change. I couldn't recommend it enough!

Carson, we’re truly sorry to see that your experience wasn’t satisfactory. We understand that something must not have met your expectations. We work hard to provide a high standard of care and service to every customer and pet, and we regret that your experience didn’t reflect this. Thank you for your feedback. We take all reviews seriously and are continuously working to improve. Please contact our manager, Layla, at (708)835-4523. She would be happy to discuss your experience and address any concerns.

I am so appreciative when the people at the front desk tell me how my dog did during the day. My pup is less than two years old and new to this kind of daycare environment, but they've socially opened up so much here. I get her grooming here now too and Mya always does a great job :)
Thank you for the 5-star review! We’re happy to know you had a great experience at Dogaholics.
My dog came back with a wound on his nose, and an iffy haircut

Dogaholics, and their staff, is consistently wonderful. They have a genuine care for dogs of all sizes, good daycare/boarding options and offer a variety of package add-ons.

In particular, their groomer/stylist is amazing. She makes sure to check on desired cut length and focus-areas, I can tell she clearly takes time during the groom to make my dog comfortable & trusting, and the glow ups are always a 10/10.
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We’re happy to know you’re pleased with Dogaholics. We look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon!

My wife and I came in from out of town to do some sailing and needed a place to drop our pup while we were on the water.  The staff was very helpful and took grand care of our dog for boarding while we went and splashed around on the lake.  We would absolutely use them again.
They did an excellent job grooming our mini sheepadoodle! Everyone was so nice! We will definitely be a regular customer!
Mia at Dogaholics is a wonderful groomer! Lulu loves her!! And so do I    !!!!
These guys are the best!
My pup loves this place! They are super friendly and he comes home wiped out from a fun day. I recommend!

Update: Sadly Dogaholics quality of services and professionalism has drastically changed with the changes in ownership and staff over the years our dog has spent there. Most recently they declined to accept a boarding reservation 24 hours before a trip due to concern our dog would be “grumpy” during a longer stay despite being loyal customers for many years and no previous report to us about concerns about her behavior with other dogs. We had our own concerns after they notified us about a canine flu outbreaks but the reasoning they provided for declining our reservation entirely was ridiculous. We were left scrambling. They also no longer post pictures of the dogs which was one of our favorite parts of their care and no longer provide the same quality updates or care they did before ownership changed. Would NOT recommend.

Prior review: Dogaholics truly is the best! They do an amazing job taking care of our sweet rescue Malala. We weren’t sure how it would go at first since Malala used to be nervous around new people, but Dogaholics has brought out so much more confidence in her. Playing with other dogs there maintains her doggy social skills too. The pictures they post of her playing with other pups brightens up our work days and the staff does a great job with updates when we pick her up too. We can tell how much they love her and make her part of their family.

My yellow lab has been going to Dogaholics for about a year and a half, and she loves it! Every day when we walk in she ditches me immediately in her excitement to head to the back with the other dogs. The staff seem to genuinely love her, and I trust them completely. We have also utilized the transport service which was unbelievably convenient. We’ve now moved out of range, but I still drive her there and drop her off each morning before commuting - that’s how much we love it!
Everyone is so warm and friendly here. They make me feel like my dog is their favorite. I love their set up for daycare and their groomer is the best!
We've done boarding with them a couple times, and they've always taken great care of our boy. They've also been very communicative if there were ever any issues or questions.

Great place for boarding! They take great care of my pup and have always been great when there have been travel issues and I’ve needed to extend my pup’s stay. Love the puppy postcards and the outdoor space for summer.
